# Sofiene Khiari

> Pharmacist and software developer, pursuing a PhD in the Computational Pharmacy Group at the University of Basel. Works on deep learning and agentic AI for molecular docking and drug discovery, and advocates for open source software and open science.

## Pages

- [Home](https://sofk.ch/): Biography and the full academic and professional history, presented as a git commit log.
- [Publications](https://sofk.ch/publications/): Peer-reviewed publications and preprints in computational pharmacy, molecular docking and drug discovery.
- [Talks](https://sofk.ch/talks/): Talks given, each rewritten as a readable article rather than published as slides.

## Publications

- [Synthetic Protein-Ligand Complex Generation for Deep Molecular Docking](https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2509.12915): Sofiene Khiari, Matthew R. Masters, Amr H. Mahmoud, Markus A. Lill. arXiv, 2025, preprint.
